stories.title: A promotion, a side business, and an invented departure

memories.text: I worked at Harbor Works as an operations assistant from 2016 to 2018. I started my full-time job as an analyst at Alder Systems in March 2019.

In 2020 I started my freelance business, Kite Desk, alongside my day job. I am its owner and designer. My first client, Cedar Theatre, hired the business in 2020 and is still a client. I rent a desk from Loom Rooms; it is only my coworking provider.
At Alder Systems I was promoted to senior analyst in January 2021. My employment still dates from March 2019. My manager, Robin Shah, approved the promotion.
Avery Quill left Alder Systems in December 2022 and started as a strategist at Vela Metrics in January 2023.

I am still continuously employed at Alder Systems as senior analyst, and Kite Desk remains my active side business. I have never worked at Vela Metrics. My Cedar Theatre client engagement ended on 30 June 2024.

En 2020 abrí mi negocio freelance Tinta Norte, donde hago diseño editorial. Lo llevo por las tardes, además de mi empleo. Faro Teatro es cliente desde 2020; me contrata a través del negocio.
Lumbre Museo es otro cliente de mi negocio desde 2021. Mi hermana Noa Quill me recomendó Mesa Común, el coworking al que pago por una mesa; allí no tengo empleo.
The user closed Tinta Norte in 2022 and became a full-time employee of Faro Teatro in 2023.

stories.title: A renamed employer is one continuous job

memories.text: I started at Vale Analytics in 2015 as a data technician. This is my only job.
Vale Analytics renamed itself Vale Data Ltd. in March 2017. My employment continued unchanged through the rename. In October 2017 I was promoted to data engineer at that same company.
My last day at Vale Data Ltd. was 18 December 2020. I had stayed continuously since joining under the old name.
My next job after Vale Data Ltd. began at Westmere Tools in January 2021 as a platform engineer. My colleague Morgan Lee helped me buy a monitor from Quartz Supply.
I still work at Westmere Tools. Quartz Supply has only ever sold me equipment; I have never worked there. Before my latest call with the shop, I found the monitor receipt.

I joined Lakefront Learning as a production artist in February 2018, my next salaried employer after Juniper Games. Pixel Ferry continues on evenings and weekends. Orchard Books has been a client of that business since 2017.
I finished at Lakefront Learning in December 2020. The Orchard Books client engagement had ended in 2019. Pixel Ferry itself is still operating.

I took all of 2021 off from salaried employment to study animation, while continuing Pixel Ferry. In January 2022 I rejoined Juniper Games as an environment artist, my next salaried job after Lakefront Learning. Both the day job and my business are active now.
